SELECT 1
            FROM documents, json_tree(documents.document, '$.v') AS candidate
            WHERE db_name = 'review3' AND coll_name = 'binary'
              AND CASE WHEN candidate.type = 'object'
                       THEN json_extract(candidate.value, '$."$mongoeco".type') END = 'int64'
            LIMIT 1

SELECT 1
            FROM documents, json_tree(documents.document, '$.v') AS candidate
            WHERE db_name = 'review3' AND coll_name = 'binary'
              AND CASE WHEN candidate.type = 'object'
                       THEN json_extract(candidate.value, '$."$mongoeco".type') END = 'decimal'
            LIMIT 1

            LIMIT 1

SELECT 1
            FROM documents
            WHERE db_name = 'review3' AND coll_name = 'binary'
              AND json_type(document, '$.v') = 'array'
            LIMIT 1

SELECT document
            FROM documents
            WHERE db_name = 'review3' AND coll_name = 'binary' AND (COALESCE(json_extract(document, '$.v."$mongoeco".type'), '') = 'bytes' AND COALESCE(json_extract(document, '$.v."$mongoeco".value'), json_extract(document, '$.v')) = '6162')

SELECT document
            FROM documents
            WHERE db_name = 'review3' AND coll_name = 'binary' AND ((COALESCE(json_extract(document, '$.v."$mongoeco".type'), '') = 'bytes' AND COALESCE(json_extract(document, '$.v."$mongoeco".value'), json_extract(document, '$.v')) = '6162') OR (json_type(document, '$.v') = 'array' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(document, '$.v') WHERE json_each.type = 'object' AND COALESCE(json_extract(json_each.value, '$."$mongoeco".type'), '') = 'bytes' AND COALESCE(json_extract(json_each.value, '$."$mongoeco".value'), json_extract(json_each.value, '$')) = '6162')))
